tools.name: truecontext_list_formspaces
tools.description: List the FormSpaces (work areas) in your TrueContext account. FormSpace ids go into the other tools. Uses GET /api/1.1/formspaces.

tools.name: truecontext_get_formspace
tools.description: Get the details of one FormSpace. Uses GET /api/1.1/formspaces/{formSpaceId}.

tools.name: truecontext_list_forms
tools.description: List the forms in one FormSpace. Uses GET /api/1.1/formspaces/{formSpaceId}/forms.

tools.name: truecontext_get_form
tools.description: Get the details of one form in a FormSpace. Uses GET /api/1.1/formspaces/{formSpaceId}/forms/{formId}.

tools.name: truecontext_list_form_versions
tools.description: List the versions (iterations) of one form. Uses GET /api/1.1/formspaces/{formSpaceId}/forms/{formId}/iterations.

tools.name: truecontext_get_form_version
tools.description: Get the details of one form version. Uses GET /api/1.1/formspaces/{formSpaceId}/forms/{formId}/iterations/{formVersionId}.

tools.name: truecontext_list_submissions
tools.description: List dispatched and submitted forms (form submissions). Filter by name, FormSpace, form, version, group, user or state. Dates use the ftime field with stime and etime. Uses GET /api/1.1/data.

tools.name: truecontext_get_submission
tools.description: Get the details of one form submission. Uses GET /api/1.1/data/{dataId}.

tools.name: truecontext_list_data_sources
tools.description: List the data sources (lookups) in one FormSpace. Uses GET /api/1.1/formspaces/{formSpaceId}/sources.

tools.name: truecontext_get_data_source
tools.description: Get the details of one data source. Uses GET /api/1.1/formspaces/{formSpaceId}/sources/{sourceId}.

tools.name: truecontext_list_destinations
tools.description: List the data destinations in one FormSpace (where submitted data is sent). Uses GET /api/1.1/formspaces/{formSpaceId}/destinations.

tools.name: truecontext_list_resources
tools.description: List the resources (documents and images for field users) in one FormSpace. Uses GET /api/1.1/formspaces/{formSpaceId}/resources.

tools.name: truecontext_list_groups
tools.description: List the user groups in your TrueContext account. Uses GET /api/1.1/groups.

tools.name: truecontext_list_users
tools.description: List the user accounts in your TrueContext account. Uses GET /api/1.1/users.

tools.name: truecontext_fetch_data_source
tools.description: Ask TrueContext to fetch fresh data for a dynamic data source now, which updates that source. Not for manual upload or user-list sources. Read-only keys cannot use it. Each call runs a new fetch. Uses POST /api/1.1/formspaces/{formSpaceId}/sources/{sourceId}/fetch.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: truecontext_fetch_data_source · Private data: truecontext_list_resources · Public sink: truecontext_fetch_data_source.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: truecontext_fetch_data_source · Private data: truecontext_list_resources · Public sink: truecontext_fetch_data_source

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
